svg.title: Average of averages vs naive average — SQL concept diagram
svg.desc: Shows how the CTE computes per-customer averages first, then averages those, versus the naive single-level average that treats all orders equally.

g.text: Naive avg is skewed by high-volume customers (Bob's $200 gets 1 vote).
Avg-of-avgs gives each customer equal weight regardless of order count.
